title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：police　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 police 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the clerk ① called the police that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the calling was the whole of the month. The ② police, meaning the force itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; police, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of police in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ police at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Police, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the police was the whole of the matter, meaning the order and not the force. The ⑥ police, meaning the order and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; police, he said, is either something you call or the only word that means both force and an order. He said the order is the part they remember.

By 1995 the ⑦ police had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ police of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; police, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ police I remember is the police described in the file, which closed in 1997 and is still described as the quietest in the office. ⑩ Police, my mother said in 1999, is the only thing that improves by being described; all police, she said, is an order that has agreed to look like force. She said the order was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 警察（指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 警察（指那名警察本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：call the police 报这一名警察
D. n. 警察（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 警察之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的警察之事）
F. n. 警察（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一名）
G. n. 警察、秩序（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 秩序（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: called the police that no applicant in the office would have described
The police, meaning the force itself and not the stamp
Every sort of police in that office
the police at the far counter

The police of the whole thing

answers.why: call the police 意为“报这一名警察”，1990 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一名警察做了一遍。
police 意为“警察”，指那名警察本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
police 意为“警察”，指办事处里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
police 意为“警察”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
police 意为“警察、秩序”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这名秩序就是那件事的全部。
police 意为“秩序”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那名警察，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
police 意为“警察”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一名，到 1995 年这一名成了卷宗里的一行。
police 意为“警察之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的警察之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
police 意为“警察”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一名，1997 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一名。
police 为抽象总称，母亲 1999 年说，警察是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的警察。
